group.title: A temporary bus-stop change
group.passage: This is a service announcement for Route Twelve passengers. Because of roadwork on Pine Avenue, buses will not stop at City Library from Tuesday through Friday. During that period, please use the temporary stop outside the swimming pool on Oak Street, about a five-minute walk from the library. The first and last departure times will remain unchanged. However, journeys may take up to ten minutes longer during the evening rush hour. Wheelchair access is available at the temporary stop. We apologize for the inconvenience and expect normal service to resume on Saturday.
group.passageZh: 這是給十二號路線乘客的服務公告。由於 Pine Avenue 道路施工，星期二至星期五公車不會停靠市立圖書館。這段期間，請改到 Oak Street 游泳池外的臨時站牌，從圖書館步行約五分鐘可達。首班與末班發車時間維持不變。不過晚間尖峰的車程可能會增加最多十分鐘。臨時站設有輪椅通行設施。造成不便敬請見諒，預計星期六恢復正常服務。

questions.prompt: Why is the City Library stop temporarily unavailable?
questions.promptZh: 市立圖書館站為什麼暫時無法使用？

options.text: The library has permanently closed.
options.whyZh: 變更是道路施工造成，沒有圖書館永久歇業。

options.text: All bus drivers are attending training.
options.whyZh: 路線仍營運，只改停臨時站，並未提司機訓練。

options.text: The swimming pool is being demolished.
options.whyZh: 游泳池外正是臨時站地點，沒有拆除消息。

options.text: Roadwork is taking place nearby.
options.zh: 附近正在進行道路工程。
options.whyZh: 公告開頭以 Because of roadwork on Pine Avenue 交代改站原因。

questions.explanationZh: 公告開頭以 Because of roadwork on Pine Avenue 交代改站原因。
questions.evidence: Because of roadwork on Pine Avenue

options.text: Inside City Library.
options.whyZh: 圖書館站暫停停靠，臨時站也不在建築內。

options.text: At the airport entrance.
options.whyZh: 公告沒有提及機場。

options.text: Outside the swimming pool on Oak Street.
options.whyZh: 公告清楚指出臨時站位於 Oak Street 的泳池外，離圖書館約五分鐘步行距離。

options.text: Behind the Pine Avenue railway station.
options.whyZh: Pine Avenue 是施工道路，並未提到火車站。

questions.explanationZh: 公告清楚指出臨時站位於 Oak Street 的泳池外，離圖書館約五分鐘步行距離。
questions.evidence: the temporary stop outside the swimming pool on Oak Street

vocabulary.note: 在原站不能使用時替代服務的停靠位置。

questions.prompt: What should evening rush-hour passengers allow for?
questions.promptZh: 晚間尖峰時段乘客應預留什麼？

options.text: A new fare for wheelchair users.
options.whyZh: 公告只說臨時站有輪椅通行設施，未更改票價。

options.text: The cancellation of the last bus.
options.whyZh: 首班與末班時間維持不變，沒有取消末班。

options.text: A potentially longer journey.
options.whyZh: 公告說尖峰車程最多可能增加十分鐘；雖首末班不變，乘客仍應多留行車時間。

options.text: A twenty-minute walk from the library.
options.zh: 從圖書館步行二十分鐘。
options.whyZh: 步行距離約五分鐘；最多十分鐘是車程增加量。

questions.explanationZh: 公告說尖峰車程最多可能增加十分鐘；雖首末班不變，乘客仍應多留行車時間。
questions.evidence: journeys may take up to ten minutes longer during the evening rush hour.

vocabulary.note: 通勤需求集中、路況較壅塞的時段。
